unitTitle: A2 capstone: handle a changing week
title: Phrases
subtitle: A2 · Unit 12: A2 capstone: handle a changing week

steps.title: Phrases
steps.body: Use the short phrases as tools, not as scripts. Write one version for your own week. Then change the date, destination and problem and explain the new plan without looking.

steps.title: Say the whole block
steps.body: Learn these as blocks, exactly as you hear them. Say each one out loud. Tap the speaker to hear it.

steps.fr: Je n'ai pas compris le nouvel horaire. Pourriez-vous le répéter ?
steps.en: I did not understand the new schedule. Could you repeat it?
steps.tip: Say it: zhuh neh pah kohn-PREE luh noo-VEHL oh-REHR; poo-ree-YAY luh ray-pay-TAY

steps.fr: Il pleuvait quand le bus est arrivé, donc je vais prendre un autre itinéraire.
steps.en: It was raining when the bus arrived, so I am going to take another route.
steps.tip: Say it: eel pluh-vay kah(n) luh büs eh tah-ree-VAY; dohnk zhuh veh prahn-druh uh(n) nohtr ee-tee-nay-REHR

steps.fr: Je lui demande le point de départ et je note l'heure.
steps.en: I ask them for the starting point and note the time.
steps.tip: Say it: zhuh LÜ-ee duh-MAH(N)D luh pwa(n) duh day-PAHR; zhuh noht luhr

steps.fr: La deuxième option est plus courte, mais la première est plus simple.
steps.en: The second option is shorter, but the first is simpler.
steps.tip: Say it: lah duh-ZYEHM ohp-SYOH(N) eh plü koort; meh lah pruh-MYEHR eh plü SA(N)PL

steps.fr: Je vais y aller après le cours et j'enverrai un message.
steps.en: I will go there after class and send a message.
steps.tip: Say it: zhuh veh zee ah-LAY ah-preh luh koor; zhah(n)-vayr-RAY uh(n) meh-SAHZH

steps.fr: Je voudrais confirmer la prochaine étape.
steps.en: I would like to confirm the next step.
steps.tip: Say it: zhuh voo-DREH kohn-feer-MAY lah proh-SHEHN ay-TAHP

steps.fr: D'abord, je résume le problème; ensuite, je justifie mon choix.
steps.en: First, I summarize the problem; then, I justify my choice.
steps.tip: Say it: dah-BOHR zhuh ray-ZÜM luh proh-BLEHM; ah(n)-SWEEHT zhuh zhüs-tee-FEE moh(n) shwah

steps.fr: Je sais faire cet essai sans aide, mais je dois revoir les pronoms.
steps.en: I can do this attempt without help, but I need to review the pronouns.
steps.tip: Say it: zhuh seh fehr sehr eh-SEH sah(n) ehd; meh zhuh dwah ruh-VWAHR lay proh-NOH(N)
